title: Norvik Analytics raises $45M Series B led by Halcyon Ventures
description: Oslo-based Norvik Analytics, which sells demand forecasting software to retailers, has raised a $45 million Series B led by Halcyon Ventures, with participation from existing investor Fjord Capital. The round brings Norvik Analytics' total funding to $61 million. CEO Ingrid Solberg said the money will fund expansion into Germany and the UK.
